description: This file defines the ShuffleInMemorySorter class used for in-memory sorting of shuffle data in Apache Spark, including sorting algorithms, memory management, and record insertion.

classes.name: ShuffleInMemorySorter
classes.description: A class for in-memory sorting of shuffle data, supporting radix and Tim sort, with memory management and record insertion.

classes.name: ShuffleInMemorySorter.ShuffleSorterIterator
classes.description: An iterator-like class for traversing sorted record pointers efficiently.

methods.name: getUsableCapacity
methods.description: Calculates the usable capacity of the array based on whether radix sort is used.

methods.name: numRecords
methods.description: Returns the number of records currently inserted.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the sorter, reinitializing the array and capacity.

methods.name: expandPointerArray
methods.description: Expands the internal array to a new larger array.

methods.name: hasSpaceForAnotherRecord
methods.description: Checks if there is space for inserting another record.

methods.name: getMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns the current memory usage of the array.

methods.name: insertRecord
methods.description: Inserts a record pointer and partition id into the sorter.

methods.name: getSortedIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the sorted record pointers.
